test_inputs.explanation: The base_admin_url is taken from the repeated URLs: all admin pages start with http://dockerized-magento.local. The product_id comes from the edit URLs: /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/2783/ shows that 2783 was the product being edited. The execution summary does not expose any concrete values for username, password, product name, SKU, or quantity (all actions are listed as 'unknown' and no form data is shown), so those fields are left as empty strings because actual values cannot be reliably inferred from the trace.
